mapper.sql: stock_id, item_type, item_id, product_id, shop_dept_id, warehouse_id, current_quantity, locked_quantity, available_quantity, cost_price, total_cost, version

reservation_id, transfer_id, transfer_detail_id, reservation_round, stock_id, item_type, item_id, source_location_dept_id, reserved_quantity, consumed_quantity, released_quantity, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select business_root.dept_id from sys_dept source_dept straight_join sys_dept target_dept on source_dept.dept_id = #{sourceWarehouseId} and target_dept.dept_id = #{targetStoreId} straight_join sys_dept business_root on business_root.dept_id = cast( case when source_dept.ancestors is null or source_dept.ancestors = '' or source_dept.ancestors = '0' then source_dept.dept_id when source_dept.ancestors like '0,%' then substring_index(substring_index( source_dept.ancestors, ',', 2), ',', -1) else substring_index(source_dept.ancestors, ',', 1) end as unsigned ) where source_dept.del_flag = '0' and source_dept.status = '0' and source_dept.dept_type = 'WAREHOUSE' and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.dept_type = 'STORE' and business_root.del_flag = '0' and business_root.status = '0' and business_root.dept_id = cast( case when target_dept.ancestors is null or target_dept.ancestors = '' or target_dept.ancestors = '0' then target_dept.dept_id when target_dept.ancestors like '0,%' then substring_index(substring_index( target_dept.ancestors, ',', 2), ',', -1) else substring_index(target_dept.ancestors, ',', 1) end as unsigned ) for update

select s.stock_id, s.item_type, s.item_id, s.product_id, s.shop_dept_id, s.warehouse_id, s.current_quantity, s.locked_quantity, s.available_quantity, s.cost_price, s.total_cost, s.version from inv_stock s
straight_join inv_product p on p.product_id = coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id)
straight_join sys_dept item_owner on item_owner.dept_id = p.shop_dept_id straight_join sys_dept source_dept on source_dept.dept_id = #{locationDeptId}
straight_join inv_gift_box gift on gift.gift_id = coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id)
where coalesce(s.item_type, 'product') = #{itemType} and coalesce(s.item_id, s.product_id) = #{itemId} and s.shop_dept_id = #{locationDeptId} and s.warehouse_id = #{locationDeptId}
and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0'
and p.shop_dept_id is not null and source_dept.del_flag = '0' and source_dept.status = '0' and source_dept.dept_type = 'WAREHOUSE' and item_owner.del_flag = '0' and item_owner.status = '0' and ( item_owner.dept_id = source_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(source_dept.dept_id, item_owner.ancestors) or find_in_set(item_owner.dept_id, source_dept.ancestors) )
and gift.del_flag = '0' and gift.status = '0'
and 1 = 0
for update
select from inv_stock where stock_id = #{stockId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into inv_transfer_reservation ( transfer_id, transfer_detail_id, reservation_round, stock_id, item_type, item_id, source_location_dept_id, reserved_quantity, consumed_quantity, released_quantity, status, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{transferId}, #{transferDetailId}, #{reservationRound}, #{stockId}, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{sourceLocationDeptId}, #{reservedQuantity}, 0, 0, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update inv_transfer_reservation set reserved_quantity = reserved_quantity + #{quantity}, status = case when consumed_quantity = 0 and released_quantity = 0 then 'ACTIVE' else 'PARTIAL' end, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and version = #{version} and #{quantity} > 0

update inv_transfer_reservation
set status = case when consumed_quantity + released_quantity + #{quantity} = reserved_quantity then case when released_quantity = 0 then 'CONSUMED' else 'CLOSED' end else 'PARTIAL' end, consumed_quantity = consumed_quantity + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and version = #{version} and #{quantity} > 0 and reserved_quantity - consumed_quantity - released_quantity >= #{quantity}

update inv_transfer_reservation
set status = case when consumed_quantity + released_quantity + #{quantity} = reserved_quantity then case when consumed_quantity = 0 then 'RELEASED' else 'CLOSED' end else 'PARTIAL' end, released_quantity = released_quantity + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and version = #{version} and #{quantity} > 0 and reserved_quantity - consumed_quantity - released_quantity >= #{quantity}
